CTrigger (this doc) is an engine primitive (watched-list + latched enter/exit dispatch) with no placeable FourCC and no native file implementing it directly. C3DTriggerType's one owned runtime method is flagged in its own doc as still-raw decompiler output, too poor an L1 to certify. Returns to native-port; a future pass porting C3DTrigger's real cascade or resolving TRIG's RTTI could open a genuine linked aspect.
